chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from al-Husayn ibn 'Uthman, from Ibn Muskan, from Abi Bakr al-Hadrami, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who performs salat while his dye-cloth is upon him. He said: He should not perform salat while it is upon him; rather, he should remove it when he wants to perform salat. I said: His henna and his cloth are clean. He said: He should not perform salat while it is upon him, and the woman also should not perform salat while her dye-cloth is upon her.

key_terms.خِضَابُهُ: his dyeing material or dye-cloth associated with henna application

ai.seo_question: Can a person perform salat while wearing the cloth used for henna dyeing if it is clean?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat in the cloth used for dyeing with henna. Even if the henna and the cloth are clean, the Imam عليه السلام states that one should remove it before performing salat, and the same ruling applies to women.
